title: Phase Diagram of the Interacting Bose Gas
exact_target: Prove the predicted three-dimensional Bose-gas phases: exponential decay below criticality, power laws at criticality, and condensation above it.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003146 (OWR-14608-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
The Renormalization Group (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/26, pp. 1453--1515. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 34.

status_qualification: The interaction and thermodynamic parameters are source-specific. The nonclustering assertion refers to the condensate correlation channel, not a claim that every connected observable correlation ceases to decay.
